title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along practical off-campus corridors around Augustana College, each paired with one sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Quad Cities-Style Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow 14th Avenue to Harris Pizza for its original Quad Cities-style pizza; check the current menu before placing a pickup order.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding local pizza counter serving lunch and dinner near College Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: Harris Pizza lists its Rock Island location at 3903 14th Avenue and identifies it as a source of original Quad Cities-style pizza.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists takeout and hours through 8 p.m. or later daily; verify hours before leaving.

cards.title: Mexican Food Near Campus
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue east on 14th Avenue to La Rancherita for breakfast, lunch or dinner, then confirm service details before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Mexican restaurant within the College Hill orbit.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois tourism’s direct listing places La Rancherita at 4118 14th Avenue and says the family-operated restaurant serves Mexican specialties for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
cards.access_notes: The listing describes dine-in and carryout but does not provide dependable current hours; call ahead.

cards.title: Pizza and Ice Cream Stop
cards.subtitle: 30th Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk south on 30th Street to the Rock Island Happy Joe’s for pizza or ice cream; use the location page to check daily hours.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented pizza destination on College Hill’s main north–south street.
cards.evidence_claim: Happy Joe’s official location page lists the Rock Island restaurant at 1412 30th Street, with pizza service, an open dining area, carryout and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 10 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–9 p.m. Friday–Saturday; recheck before visiting.

cards.title: Browse Mid-Century Finds
cards.subtitle: 30th Street corridor at 14th Avenue
cards.notes: Pause at the 30th Street and 14th Avenue corner to browse vintage clothing, records and décor; confirm opening hours first.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive antiques shop focused on mid-century collectibles.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Quad Cities places Fred & Ethel’s at 1326 30th Street and describes its selection of mid-century furniture, décor, clothing, kitchenware and vinyl records.
cards.access_notes: The destination listing does not establish current operating hours; verify directly before making a special trip.

cards.title: Coffeehouse Break
cards.subtitle: 30th Street corridor
cards.notes: Head down 30th Street to Cool Beanz for coffee, espresso, tea, smoothies or food; check current service hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: An independent College Hill coffeehouse with drinks and an all-day food selection.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Quad Cities identifies Cool Beanz Coffeehouse at 1325 30th Street and documents coffee, espresso drinks, teas, smoothies and food from breakfast through dinner.
cards.source_title: Cool Beanz Coffeehouse | Visit Quad Cities
cards.access_notes: The cited page does not provide current hours; consult the business before visiting.

cards.title: Ice Cream on 18th Avenue
cards.subtitle: 18th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take 18th Avenue west to Whitey’s for an ice-cream stop; open the official locations page to confirm the day’s hours first.
cards.short_summary: The Rock Island outpost of a regional ice-cream company founded in the Quad Cities.
cards.evidence_claim: Whitey’s official locations page lists its Rock Island shop at 2520 18th Avenue and notes that the location has a drive-through.
cards.access_notes: The official page links to location hours but does not expose them in the cited text; verify before departure.

cards.title: Library Space on 30th Street
cards.subtitle: 30th Street corridor south of campus
cards.notes: Follow 30th Street south to Watts-Midtown for library study space, collections or programs; check the live schedule before going.
cards.short_summary: Rock Island Public Library’s Midtown branch offers a substantial public indoor destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Rock Island Public Library lists Watts-Midtown Branch at 2715 30th Street and publishes its regular location hours and events.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 9 a.m.–8 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–6 p.m. Friday, with shorter Saturday hours and Sunday closure.

cards.title: Courts, Theater and Sledding
cards.subtitle: 11th Avenue and 38th Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter Lincoln Park from 11th Avenue or 38th Street for tennis, the bandshell or playground; observe posted facility-use rules.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge municipal park combining recreation areas and an outdoor performance setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rock Island locates Lincoln Park at 11th Avenue and 38th Street and lists tennis courts, an outdoor theater, playground equipment and sledding.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park | City of Rock Island
cards.access_notes: The city lists park hours as sunrise–10 p.m.; public tennis access can be limited by Augustana team use.

cards.title: Disc Golf and Garden Paths
cards.subtitle: 18th Avenue corridor at 17th Street
cards.notes: Travel west along 18th Avenue to walk Longview Park’s paths or play its 18-hole disc-golf course; bring your own discs.
cards.short_summary: A hilly municipal park with gardens, trails and a full disc-golf layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Rock Island’s facility page places Longview Park at 18th Avenue and 17th Street and documents an 18-hole disc-golf course, flower gardens and a walk/jog trail.
cards.source_title: Longview Park | City of Rock Island
cards.access_notes: The city lists general park hours as sunrise–10 p.m.; terrain is described as hilly.

cards.title: Prairie Architecture and Gardens
cards.subtitle: 24th Street corridor at 13th Avenue
cards.notes: Approach from 24th Street to see the Prairie-style estate and Jensen-designed gardens; visit only during public access hours.
cards.short_summary: A city-owned historic mansion framed by terraced gardens and native landscaping.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rock Island lists Hauberg Estate at 1300 24th Street and documents its Prairie mansion, native plant landscape, terraced garden, ponds and waterfall.
cards.source_title: Hauberg Estate | City of Rock Island
cards.access_notes: Listed public hours are 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Tuesday–Friday; weekends are reserved for private rentals, so confirm access.
